description:
Learn how to make a Roblox game with ChatGPT Codex, from a blank Roblox Studio project to a playable obstacle course. Build three themed worlds, add an animated blimp, and use computer use to test the game and fix issues. No coding experience needed to follow along.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
Sponsored by: @OpenAI 

📚 RESOURCES
- Download ChatGPT: https://chatgpt.com/download
- Roblox Studio: https://create.roblox.com/

PROMPT 1: BUILD THE GAME
Create a Roblox obstacle course game with 3 stages, jumping platforms, lava hazards, checkpoints, collectible coins, and a finish line. Make it colorful and beginner-friendly. Build it directly in my open Roblox Studio project and test the basic gameplay.

PROMPT 2: REDESIGN THE WORLDS
Redesign my existing Roblox obstacle course to make it look and feel like a polished Roblox game.

Keep the existing gameplay mechanics, including checkpoints, coins, hazards, and the finish line.
